## What changed

Describe the user-visible change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] Lint, TypeScript, unit tests, browser tests, and production build pass.
- [ ] Relevant tests cover the changed behavior.
- [ ] Mobile and keyboard behavior checked for UI changes.
- [ ] No credentials or private Appwrite data included.

## Release notes

Mention required environment variables, database permission changes, or snapshot updates. Use `dev` as the target for feature PRs; release to `main` through a separate PR.
